RESOLUTION APPOINTING A MEMBER OF THE “LAURENS-TREUTLEN JOINT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY”; PROVIDING FOR SUCH MEMBER’S TERM OF OFFICE AND RELATED MATTERS

WHEREAS, a concurrent resolution (“Amended and Restated Activating Resolution”) has been, or is being, presented for adoption by the governing bodies of Laurens County and Treutlen County (each a “Participating Jurisdiction”) to amend and restate the tesolution that created and activated a joint development authority to operate in those Participating Jurisdictions to be known as the “Laurens-Treutlen Joint Development Authority” (the “JDA”), and for certain other purposes; and

WHEREAS, this governing body has adopted such Amended and Restated Activating Resolution, and adopts this resolution to appoint one (1) taxpayer and resident of Treutlen County, Georgia to serve as the member of the JDA appointed by this governing body after the effectiveness of the Amended and Restated Activating Resolution, and to provide for such member’s term of office;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that:
1:
Effective upon the effectiveness of the Amended and Restated Activating Resolution, the following person, who is a taxpayer and resident of Treutlen County, Georgia, is hereby appointed to serve as this Participating Jurisdiction’s member of the JDA to serve, in accordance with the Amended and Restated Activating Resolution, for a term ending on the date indicated below:

NAME OF MEMBER TERM ENDS Andy Thompson 12/31/2019

adoption, provided that the appointment made above shall be effective on and after the effectiveness of the Amended and Restated Activating Resolution.
